title: B-tree active-backup observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeIsInBackup reports whether the Btree handle currently has one or more backup operations attached, under the owning connection mutex.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source observation is assigned; native backup owner integration remains open.

inputs: Non-null Btree under the owning connection mutex
contracts.ownership: Borrowed Btree; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Any positive backup count maps to true; zero maps to false.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Null or unlocked input violates source assertions; otherwise total.

representation_differences: The Zig Btree.backup_count usize represents source Btree.nBackup; lock ownership remains a caller contract.

oracle.protocol: Observe a Btree initialized with zero backup owners and compare false; positive-count/native attach trace remains pending.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; connection mutex and backup count mutation remain external.
assurance.continuation: Pure observation leaves backup state unchanged.

integration.native_call_path: Typed predicate and zero-count trace exist; backup_core currently owns a separate backup-count model.

independent_review.notes: Requires backup attach/detach integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Unify backup_core backup_count with the Btree handle owner.
